review:
Running Sushi is a 5x4 sushi-bar slot. After every spin, a random number of sushi plates with multipliers appear on a conveyor belt below the reels, and three Take Sushi symbols add up the conveyor's values and multiply the total by the bet.

Sushi chef scatters trigger 10 free spins, where conveyor multipliers accumulate instead of resetting between spins. The in-game screens advertise up to 3,000x. Note the RTP is 96%. A fun, light theme with a clear mechanic.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
